Arabidopsis gene pairs and collinear blocks

Source: MCScanX official at.gff and at.blast example data.
Upstream commit: 0956cb8f900c152e2be8ba3196829e50ab454b94
https://github.com/wyp1125/MCScanX/tree/0956cb8f900c152e2be8ba3196829e50ab454b94/data

Generated by MCScanX -a at with default parameters:
MATCH_SCORE 50; MATCH_SIZE 5; GAP_PENALTY -1; E_VALUE 1e-5;
MAX_GAPS 25; OVERLAP_WINDOW 5.
Selected blocks: 15 and 74–82, retaining all their original gene pairs.
Block endpoints are the minimum start and maximum end of constituent genes.
Gene intervals follow the source table; no exon, CDS or strand is inferred.
Chromosome lengths in the plots are TAIR10 lengths from Ensembl Plants.

Run inst/examples/prepare-synteny-data.py to regenerate the two TSV files.
Upstream license: MCScanX-LICENSE.txt.
